chapter.verse: Midang tawh a kipawl thei phalote pen amah bek thupi a kisate hi a, midangte’ cih khempeuh maan a sak khatbeek om lo hi.
Mihaite in thu a tel theih zawh nading uh kin lo uh a, pil si, a kicih theih nading bek deihna tawh thu gen uh hi.
Mawhna bawl leeng maizumna tawh kizom pah a, minsiatna ngah leeng mindaina tawh kizom pah hi.
Mihingte’ kampau in pilna kipatna suak thei a, tuipi bangin thukin, luitui bangin siang hi.
Mi mawhte angvanin diksak ding hoih lo a, midikte mawhsak ding thuman lo hi.
Mihaite in kitot nading a pat ciangin, hong sat un, ci-a a ngenngen ahi hi.
Mihaite a pau ciangin amau’ siat nading mah kampau hi a, amau kampau mah awkpih uh hi.
Gensiatna in an a lim mahmah tawh kibang a, thakhatin i sungah kihupsuk hi.
Na a susia mite a hoih loh zah mahin, a thadahte zong mihoih lo ahi hi.
Topa ’ min in tausang muanhuai tawh kibang a, thuman mite in beelin lungmuangin om thei uh hi.
Khuapi kim-a kulhpi in amah a hut bangin, a hauhna in amah a hu dingin mihaupa in ngaihsun kha hi.
A kiniamkhiatte in zahtakna ngah uh a, a kihisakte in siat ding a manawh hi ta hi.
A thu zakhin nai lopi-a dawn’kikna in, haina leh maizumhuaina ahi hi.
Mihingte’ lungsim in cinatna thuak zo sak a, mihing lungsim kisia leh cih nading dang om nawn lo hi.
Thungaihsun theite in a pilna uh behlap a, pilna a ngah nadingun mipilte in a bil uh tawh ngai uh hi.
Letsong in a piapa’ adingin lampi hon’sak a, miliante tawh kimusak thei hi.
Thukhenna zumah, a langpa in a thuk mateng, a gen masapa a thuman tawh kibang hi.
Thu a gen siam tuaktuak mi nih, zum sungah a kisel ciangin, kiciamna bek in thu khen zo hi.
Sanggamte huhna in khuapi muanhuai bangin hong hu a, sanggam tawh kitotna in kidon lohna piangsak hi.
Mi khat in a kampauna hangin gilvahna ngah ding a, a thugenna hangin nuntakna ngah ding hi.
Kampauna in sihna ahi a, hin’na ahi zongin piangsak thei a, i kampauna banga piangte san’loh phamawh hi.
Zi a mu zote na hoih a mu hi a, Topa ’ maipha a ngah ahi hi.
Mizawngte a pau ciangin thuumna kam zang a, mihaute in a dawn’ ciangin kihihsakna kam zang hi.
Lawm pawlkhatte, sauvei kimang lo a, lawm pawlkhatte, sanggam sangin kipzaw hi.
